name: Wrath of the Abyss
descriptionTemplate: 庞托斯获得 [Arg2]% 基础狂气。{灵知觉醒}：牌库中每有 3 张<DerivativeCardKeywords_145:「囚魇」>，「无休猎宴」就获得 1 层{围猎}。每打出 1 张庞托斯的卡牌，下次「无休猎宴」临时力量降低效果提高 [Arg3]%，每回合至多触发 3 次。
lore:
"What is your desire?"
Might, dominion, the restoration of the lost, a vengeance washed in blood...
He fell into a deep and gloomy silence, though the answer had long since resided in his heart—an unanswerable answer.
He wished for the sun to rise and set as usual. He wished for the world to simply go on as normal.
